description: We're a beginner team from Kyiv aviation Institute. It's our first participation in this hackaton, but we'll do ur best.
summary:
Our team developed a space mission game, that emphasizes on spaceship crises. Our main goal is to teach users how to manage crises, which are highly dependent on spacecraft structure. Game experience in general includes next phases: manufacturing your spacecraft, completing a flight and collecting data at the destination. In the process player will have to deal with real-life problems, that can appear during space travel. 
   The importance of our project is that the game will provide opportunity to work out worst possible scenarios and see how exactly manufacturing specifics can impact on execution during the mission.
details:
Details about game features

Our idea was inspired by other space-related or crisis management games, such as Voices Of The Void or Barotrauma.

The game starts with building and designing phase, which will affect following plot development. In a flight phase player or players shall prioritize among occurring emergencies and threats, that will constantly put mission in danger. In order to complete mission successfully you need to collect data from the destination.

By the end of the hackathon we`ll be having finished only middle phase demo, that is gonna contain 3 problems based on real NASA data out of 5 planned:

1)Hypercapnia and failure of the air regeneration system (ECLSS / Sabatier reactor);

2)Micrometeoroid Penetration and Depressurization;

3)Failure of the thermoregulation system;

and 2 other to develop in the future:

4)Coronal Mass Ejection (CME) and Solar Radiation;

5)Control Moment Gyroscope (CMG) Saturation and Loss of Orientation.

It will be 1 basic plot version, in which player needs to travel to the orbit of a black hole. Unfortunately, demonstration version will be simplified, so it can be done in a short term.

Intended impact

We want our product to be digital instrument to learn connection between spaceship structure and possible failures and also to practice dealing with a real-life failure cases. In other words, our project is gamification of aerospace engineer and astronaut learning.

In the future this project will be able to contain all possible failure scenarios and will include detailed spacecraft building process.

Tools

Our team selected Godot engine for developing game on C++ language, Chat-GPT and Gemini were used as assistance instruments. Models for our game were designed in Blender.

Creativeness

One of our first conceptual problems was an absence of gravity. We decided to allow to be low vertical attraction in our horizontal ship, so we avoided complex excessive coding work and it generally doesn`t affect our main purpose as much.
